Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
staffan....@mailbox.swipnet.se (staffan.bengtsson) writes:

>This is my second text for questions... Many of theese question's is explaining
>themselves, but you can't fry me for ask? Do you? DO YOU? ARGH...

>1. Do something at all stopping me from using Camille AND Raven in the same
>time?

No. They are officially two distinct vampires.

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>2. Last answer to the question "Can I burned Shackles Of Enkidu before it
>really have been used?" was a bit fuzzy, Can I?

Card text: yes.
A ruling will hopefully be handed down that overturns this.

>2b. To Burn Shackles is a D action, may i burn it if it's putted on me? Even
>If I cannot do D action's to myself?

You can't putted it on you.
If you did (somehow), then "no".

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>3. Do Dog Pack and Ghoul retainer have any errata? Do I pay the cost's with Pool
>and not blood?

Correct. No errata.

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>4. Carlotta Giovanni and other Giovanni's can bring back burned card's
>from the ash heap. Some card's definitly say that they go out-of-game when
>they are used.
>Is then the burned card's in ash heap still consiederd to be "In play" and can
>i trade my ashheap to another methusalah?

No. In play doesn't include you library, hand, nor ash heap - it only includes
face up cards "in play".

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>5. Skin Of Steel still declare's "opponent's strikes", who is the other opponent?

Whoever you are in combat with.
(The apostrophe ess indicates whose strike is being prevented, not a plural).

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ŻŻ
>6. If Mariel Lady thunder tap's to end combat between a vampire and an ally, and
>she have a Memories Of Mortality on her, does the ally take one damage or not?

Not.

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>7. The rule book (Jyhad AND Vtes) only declare that I MAY use my prevent card's
>in damage phase, So may I use prevent card's to prevent damage that is made
>outside of strike resolution?

No.

>Consider the following:

>Riposte say that the damage is unpreventable (so why can I prevent it anyway?)
> ŻŻ

You cannot.

>Mariel Lady thunder's damage is not unpreventible
> ŻŻŻ

Yes, it is.

>Wheter Control damage is unpreventible (so why can I prevent it anyway?)
> ŻŻ

You cannot.

>Pulled Fangs damage is not unpreventible

Yes, it is (unless it is played during strike resolution).

When a card says (cannot be prevented) in parentheses - it is merely
reminding you of the facts. Without the parentheses, it is overriding
the nature of the damage.

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ŻŻŻ
>8. Catonic Fear must be misspelled. There is no strike resolution at all
>considering the Vtes AND Jyhad rulebook if one part in combat use S:CE.

True. This has been pointed out (for Riposte).
The Rules Team doesn't seem to mind the paradox, and says to just
take the damage and ignore the dichotomy.

>If this is changed and Riposte IS dealing damage DURING STRIKE RESOULTION:
>Pulled Fangs damage is done after the last strike resoultion before the press
>phase, May I use it?

Yes.

>Disarm is used after the last strike resoultion before the press
>phase, May I use it?

Yes.

>May I Use decapacitate-taste of vitae with Catonic Fear - riposte ?

Yes (use taste first, since decapitate will end the combat).

>If I Attack with Wynn having 4 murder of crow's and Earth Meld, do I still do
>4 damage "during strike resolution" ?

No. The crows are governed by the rules, whereas Riposte and Catatonic Fear
are not.

>Do the full round of combat don't include strike resolution? Drawing Out The
>Beast damage do damage AFTER the strike resoultion, in the end of the round,
>Right?

Right - after Presses and everything (or, as the round ends, in the case of
Strike: Combat Ends or somesuch).

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>9. The Vtes version of Smiling Jack also deal damage to the owner of Smiling
>Jack AND cost's pool... Is this a typo?

Yes.

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>11. May I use parthanon, Anson or Rumour's of Gehenna to do more out of turn-
>masters?

No. Explicitly denied in the rulebook.

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>12: Memories Of Mortality: The damage reduced to 0... What happens if i use

>Blood To water?

OK. Burning blood is not the same as doing damage.

>Mariel Lady thunder?
>Wheather Control?

Reduced to zero.

>Carrion Crows or retainers?

Unaffected.

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>13. If I use IR goggles and Phosporus grenade: Do my eyes hurt?

Not if the range is at long.

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>14. Is Vial Of Garou blood considered an adittional Strike card?

Yes.

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>15. If I use Writ Of acceptence with an Sabbat vampire, is he
>a: Both an sabbat and a camarilla
>b: A camarilla vampire

"b"

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>16. May I Use Sabbat threat on methusalahs with only Sabbat vampires?

Yes.

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>17. Is caitiff considered to be "Non camarilla"?

No.

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>18. May an Sabbat vampire call Command Of the Harpies?

No.

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>19. May I play more than one Trap, and can both combatant's play trap?

Yes and Yes.

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>20. Thrown Gate and Aid From Bat's, when do I declare my manouver? And Do I have
>to show my manouver during manouver phase?

During the "choose range" step, and "yes"

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>21. May I somehow use Obedience on ally's?

No.

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>22. I try to block a nosferatu. The nosferatu use "Faceless night" to stealth,
>may I now use Deflection? And do I untap?

Yes, and you do not tap (if you are superior).
You do not "untap", because you weren't tapped to begin with (you only tap
when you successfully block, not hwne you attempt to block).

>22b. What about Cat's Guidence, may i untap?

Only if you successfully block.

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>23. Pulling String's, May I cancel a political action?

No, just the votes that a vampire casts.

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>24. Kindred Coercion, May i cancel the vote's of the vampire that call the
>political action?

Yes, but the Meth still gets one vote from the PA used to call the action.

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>25. Mamory's Fading Glimpse: If I use this on an Banished vampire, do the
>equipment and retainer's on that vampire go with him or to the ash heap?

Ash heap. (probably, I never got a response on this one, either).

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>26. May I use Burning Wrath or scorpion sting with melee weapons?

No.

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>27. May I choose to prevent only the aggrevated damage from a strike?

Yes.

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>29. Is Erosion the same as -1 Hand Damage or is all + damage reduced to 0?

-1 (I believe).

Messages.Author: Eric Pettersen
Messages.Body:
sjoh...@math.scarolina.edu (L. Scott Johnson) wrote:

> staffan....@mailbox.swipnet.se (staffan.bengtsson) writes:
> >2b. To Burn Shackles is a D action, may i burn it if it's putted on
> >me? Even If I cannot do D action's to myself?
>
> You can't putted it on you.
> If you did (somehow), then "no".
>

I think Scott is interpreting Staffan's question as "If I put Shackles on
my own minion, can I burn them despite it being a (D) action?" Scott
properly answers no to that. However, I think Staffan is really asking
"If someone else puts Shackles on my minion, how can I burn them since
burning them is a (D) action and you can't do (D) actions to yourself?"
The answer is that it has been ruled that even after the Shackles are
placed the controller is still the minion who placed them, so you take a
(D) action against that minion's Methuselah, not yourself.

Messages.Body:
David Pontes <l41...@alfa.ist.utl.pt> writes:
>On 1 Dec 1996, L. Scott Johnson wrote:

>> >15. If I use Writ Of acceptence with an Sabbat vampire, is he
>> >a: Both an sabbat and a camarilla
>> >b: A camarilla vampire
>>
>> "b"

> Are you sure about this, Scott? I've asked this to Jon and I

>think the answer was "a" (the vamp is masking as a Cam Vamp). Only thing
>is that it may not have 2 titles at once (as usual).

Sure? No. There hasn't been a ruling directed at this exact question,
and the Rules Team doesn't always make the obvious rulings.

As for Mr. Wilkie's response - he says that an Archbishop who becomes a
Camarilla is still an Archbishop. He doesn't say that the vampire is
still Sabbat. (He does offer a WoD explanation that may lead one to
think that the vampire is both, but WotC has proven before that they know
better than to let WoD create unweildly situations in the card game.)

Just as you can't belong to two clans at the same time, you can't
belong to two sects at the same time.

I would hope that the Rules Team verifies this position.

In article <Pine.OSF.3.91.961118...@alfa.ist.utl.pt>,
David Pontes <l41...@alfa.ist.utl.pt> wrote:

> - John Antitribu is Archbishop of Lisbon. He somehow is accepted
> via Writ of Acceptance. He calls a Praxis Seizure: Lisbon. Is he a Prince
> and an Archbishop? Can he enter combat with himself? :) (well, never mind
> the last one) The point is: don't you think having vamps belonging both
> to Camarilla and Sabbat makes things a little strange? And please, don't
> just say "screw the RPG, that's what the rules say" for it's not that
> much of an answer...

This one is so clear-cut that I can answer it. Although John can be an
Archbishop and a member of the Camarilla at the same time, as soon as he
gets another title, he loses all other titles. Therefore, when he becomes
Prince, he'd stop being Archbishop. Roleplayign explanation? He
masquerading as Camarilla, while secretly running the Sabbat in Lisbon.
This isn't too improbable; in a campaign we're running now, the Tremere
just appointed Pontifex of the city is secretly an Infernal Sabbat
Diablorist!
